- **Layer**: L3 (network)
- **Header**: 4 octets (fixed)

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `flags` | `flags(16)` | `0x0` |   | GRE flags and version (checksum / key / sequence present bits). |
| `protocol_type` | `enum(16)` | `2048` (ipv4) | Protocol number of the next layer (see Next layer) | EtherType of the encapsulated payload. |

### `flags`

| Bit | Mask | Name |
|---|---|---|
| 15 | 32768 (0x8000) | `checksum_present` |
| 13 | 8192 (0x2000) | `key_present` |
| 12 | 4096 (0x1000) | `sequence_present` |

| 34887 (0x8847) | `mpls` |

## Next layer

The next layer is selected by `protocol_type`; when the field is Auto the builder writes the value of the protocol stacked above.

| Value | Protocol | Note |
|---|---|---|
| 2048 (0x0800) | [`ipv4`](ipv4.md) |   |
| 34525 (0x86dd) | [`ipv6`](ipv6.md) |   |
| 25944 (0x6558) | [`ethernet2`](ethernet2.md) |   |
| 34887 (0x8847) | [`mpls`](mpls.md) |   |
